- Basic voucher application to draft invoices

- Prevention of multiple vouchers on same invoice
- Amount validation (positive integer only)
- No mutation of original invoice
- invoiceTotals returns voucher amount correctly
- Total calculation with voucher deduction
- Clamping of total to 0 with large vouchers
- Integration with existing discounts and VAT

All 172 tests pass.
